mapper.select: SELECT c.*, ca.cname AS categoryName, s.sname AS supplierName, i.ipath FROM commodity c LEFT JOIN category ca ON c.categoryid = ca.id LEFT JOIN supplier s ON c.supplierid = s.id LEFT JOIN image i ON c.id = i.commodityid WHERE c.cstatus = 1 ORDER BY c.createtime DESC

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO commodity (supplierid, categoryid, cname, cprice, cnum, cdesc, cstatus) VALUES (#{supplierid}, #{categoryid}, #{cname}, #{cprice}, #{cnum}, #{cdesc}, #{cstatus})
mapper.update: UPDATE commodity SET cstatus = #{cstatus} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE commodity SET cnum = cnum - #{num} WHERE id = #{id} AND cnum >= #{num}
